title: ‘Cliff Booth’ Brings Back a Fan-Favorite ‘Once Upon a Time in Hollywood’ Face
summary: Veteran actor Nicholas Hammond, who played Sam Wanamaker in "Once Upon a Time in Hollywood," talks about reprising his role in one of the sequel's Easter eggs and looks back on a career that includes "The Sound of Music" and a stint as television's first Spider-Man.
